web_evidence.title: The Host: Prologue—Inserted and Chapter 4—Dreamed
web_evidence.note: The author's authorized PDF contains a sustained third-person prologue centered on Fords Deep Waters, followed by first-person Chapter 4. The latter dramatizes Melanie's remembered experience and ends with Wanderer's first-person waking narration. The prologue is an autonomous narrative scene, not quoted speech or an embedded document.

person_note: Wanderer's participating first-person voice controls the sustained novel. The authorized excerpt shows a third-person prologue, but that brief introductory exception is not a co-controlling base strand. Melanie's remembered experience and other local voices do not create another grammatical person, so the book label is FIRST.
